en: Typhoon Haiyan, known locally as Yolanda, demonstrated the extreme destructive power of tropical cyclones with its massive storm surge.
Baguio City has a tropical highland climate, making it significantly cooler than the lowland areas of the Philippines.
Volcanic ash from Mount Pinatubo broke down into nutrient-rich soil that greatly improved the fertility of local farms.
Romblon province produces high-quality white marble, a hard metamorphic rock originally formed from ancient, compressed sea shells and coral.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River shows the water cycle in action as groundwater flows through caves directly into the sea.
Olympus Mons on Mars is the tallest known volcano in our solar system, reaching about 22 kilometers high.
Sirius, located in the constellation Canis Major, is currently the brightest star visible in the night sky.
Apollo 11 astronauts landed in Mare Tranquillitatis, a large, dark, flat plain made of cooled volcanic lava on the Moon.
Mount Mayon in Albay is famous for its perfect conical shape and its frequent, dangerous pyroclastic flows.
The Chocolate Hills in Bohol are made of over 1,200 cone-shaped mounds formed from weathered, ancient coral limestone.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive, long-lasting storm in the planet's southern hemisphere that is larger than Earth.
The Pleiades, commonly called the Seven Sisters, is a bright open star cluster easily visible in the night sky.
